search_text: published ZDI-11-336 ZDI-CAN-1278 RealNetworks RealPlayer Invalid Codec Name Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2011-11-28 CVE-2011-4255 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2011-4255 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P ['RealNetworks'] ['RealPlayer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of RealNetworks Real Player. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists when a user attempts to play a malicious video file containing a malformed codec name. When playing a malformed codec, the application will incorrectly free an object and then later attempt to use it by calling a virtual method pointer upon destruction. This can lead to code execution under the context of the application. RealNetworks has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: RealNetworks RealPlayer Invalid Codec Name Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of RealNetworks Real Player. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists when a user attempts to play a malicious video file containing a malformed codec name. When playing a malformed codec, the application will incorrectly free an object and then later attempt to use it by calling a virtual method pointer upon destruction. This can lead to code execution under the context of the application.
